name: Live / Production
description: For a game heading to release and beyond: the gameplay basics plus the platform, data and quality work shipping needs.

pillars.name: Gameplay
pillars.vision: The core loop, mechanics and rules the player interacts with.

pillars.name: Content
pillars.vision: Levels, encounters, items and other authored content.

pillars.name: Art
pillars.vision: The visual style, assets and their budgets.

pillars.name: Audio
pillars.vision: Music, sound effects and how they react to play.

pillars.name: UI
pillars.vision: Menus, HUD and how the game communicates with the player.

pillars.name: Saves
pillars.vision: Local and cloud saves, and migrating them between versions.

pillars.name: Achievements
pillars.vision: Achievements and trophies on each platform.

pillars.name: Store
pillars.vision: Store pages, purchases, DLC and entitlements.

pillars.name: Analytics
pillars.vision: What's measured, why, and how it informs design.

pillars.name: Localization
pillars.vision: Text, audio and culture across languages.

pillars.name: Accessibility
pillars.vision: Options and design that let more people play.

pillars.name: Performance
pillars.vision: Frame time, memory and load-time budgets on each target platform.
